items.source: In a typical auto-configured Spring Boot application this builder is available as a bean and can be injected whenever a ThreadPoolTaskExecutor is needed.
items.translation: 在典型的自动配置的 Spring Boot 应用程序中，该构建器作为 Bean 可用，每当需要 ThreadPoolTaskExecutor 时，都可以注入它。

items.source: Core threads can grow and shrink if allowCoreThreadTimeOut(boolean) is enabled.
items.translation: 如果启用了allowCoreThreadTimeOut(boolean)，核心线程可以增长和缩减。

items.source: If the queue capacity is unbounded, this setting is ignored.
items.translation: 如果队列容量是无界的，则忽略此设置。

items.source: Set the TaskDecorator to use or null to not use any.
items.translation: 将 TaskDecorator 设置为使用，或设置为 null` 以不使用任何装饰器。

items.source: Build a new ThreadPoolTaskExecutor instance and configure it using this builder.
items.translation: 构建一个新的ThreadPoolTaskExecutor实例，并使用此构建器进行配置。

items.source: Build a new ThreadPoolTaskExecutor instance of the specified type and configure it using this builder.
items.translation: 构建一个指定类型的新的ThreadPoolTaskExecutor实例，并使用此构建器对其进行配置。

items.source: Configure the provided ThreadPoolTaskExecutor instance using this builder.
items.translation: 使用此构建器配置提供的 ThreadPoolTaskExecutor 实例。

items.source: Set the capacity of the queue. An unbounded capacity does not increase the pool and therefore ignores maxPoolSize.
items.translation: 设置队列的容量。无界容量不会增加池的大小，因此会忽略 maxPoolSize。

items.source:
Set whether to accept further tasks after the application context close phase has
begun.
items.translation: 设置是否在应用程序上下文关闭阶段开始后接受更多任务。

items.source:
Set whether the executor should wait for scheduled tasks to complete on shutdown,
not interrupting running tasks and executing all tasks in the queue.
items.translation: 设置执行器在关闭时是否等待已调度的任务完成，不中断正在运行的任务并执行队列中的所有任务。

items.source: Set the time limit for which threads may remain idle before being terminated.
items.translation: 设置线程在空闲后被终止之前可以保持空闲的时间限制。

items.source: Set the prefix to use for the names of newly created threads.
items.translation: 设置用于新创建线程名称的前缀。

items.source:
Set whether core threads are allowed to time out. When enabled, this enables
dynamic growing and shrinking of the pool.
items.translation: 设置是否允许核心线程超时。启用此选项后，将支持线程池的动态扩容和缩容。

items.source:
Set the maximum time the executor is supposed to block on shutdown. When set, the
executor blocks on shutdown in order to wait for remaining tasks to complete their
execution before the rest of the container continues to shut down. This is
particularly useful if your remaining tasks are likely to need access to other
resources that are also managed by the container.
items.translation: 设置执行器在关闭时允许阻塞的最大时间。当设置此值时，执行器会在关闭期间进行阻塞，以等待剩余任务完成执行，然后容器其余部分才会继续关闭。如果您的剩余任务可能需要访问由容器管理的其他资源，则此功能特别有用。
